quotes.quote: Jared McCain is not star power compared to V.J. Edgecombe. And I think Jeremy McCain is a very, very good player. I can't have V.J. Edgecombe and Tyrese Maxey and then find room for Jared McCain. So what can I get for him? Did he get finagled? I would have got something more for him back if I could. There's just not enough room there. So I think that situation. Now Isaiah Joe thing is a little different, but also sometimes you can plant all the plants that you want, but you have to remove something to make room for the plants that you want to grow.
quotes.why_it_matters: This quote offers insight into the difficult roster management decisions faced by NBA front offices, explaining why promising young players might be traded to create space for star talent or other strategic fits.
